description: This file defines the Java entity class 'OrderProductAttribute' representing attributes associated with an order product in the sales management system. It maps to the 'ORDER_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTE' table in the database and includes fields like price, weight, and attribute names/values, along with relationships to other entities.

classes.name: OrderProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing an order product attribute with fields for attribute details, associated order product, and database mappings.
